notes: One determiner is written for כָּל־הָאָדָם and the כֹּל is what 'every' renders, so the article s004 is unrepresented under rule 41's limit rather than taking a fronted 'the'.

s019 הִיא is the resuming pronoun of a tripartite clause the ASV renders by nothing; the copula goes to the predicate noun מַתַּת under rule 20, and the pronoun is its own unrepresented unit under rule 22.
